where: Research Article > Taxonomic account > Murina beibengensis Luo, Mao & Zhou, sp. nov. > line under the heading 'Measurements (in mm) and body mass (in g) of the holotype.' No Class, Order or Family headings printed.
method: external measurement of the holotype as printed in the description; Methods: 'A total of 25 measurements were recorded to the nearest 0.1 mm using digital calipers' (sentence continues)
measurement: ear length of the holotype (EL: from lower edge of external auditory meatus to tip of pinna)
conditions: Holotype XZ2024037, body weight 6.20 g (BW: 6.20 in the cut part of the line). Sex is inconsistent within the paper: the Holotype paragraph prints 'Adult male, field number XZ2024037 (Figs 4, 5, Table 2)' but the Table 2 column header reads 'Holotype (Female)'; the measurement line itself states no sex and the value is the same either way. Table 2 row 'EL (ear length)' prints 16.18 for the holotype column. Values printed to 0.01 mm although Methods state calipers read to the nearest 0.1 mm. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
note: Quote is the first part of a longer measurement line (cut marked; the rest lists skull values and BW). Abbreviation expansions are from the Methods, not the quoted line (EL defined there as 'ear length (from lower edge of external auditory meatus to tip of pinna)'); the word 'holotype' is in the heading. Sibling M. medogensis EL is on main (desk-d345) and M. milinensis (desk-d347); beibengensis not on main (grepped species and DOI under any trait; an earlier note says it was withheld because of the sex conflict, which is disclosed here). Authority: Mammal Diversity Database taxon 1006943 Murina beibengensis (Luo et al. 2025, ZSE 101(3):1023-1055), species status field blank, 'recently described', opened. Licence sentence read on the article_preview page: 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' No Class/Order/Family headings printed; paper title/byline as printed in two pieces by the reader. Audit 1147: sex conflict ruled disclosable (the value is the holotype's under either sex and the record files no sex); abbreviation expansions shown by the reader are xlink:title tooltips (audit of desk-d391), so the unexpanded quote is the printed text.

measurement: TD (horizontal tympanum diameter) 2.4 mm, holotype KU336975 (Male)
method: manual caliper measurement of preserved specimens; Methods: 'Morphological measurements were taken by MV with a manual caliper with a precision of 0.1 mm.'; item (4) of the Methods measurement list is horizontal tympanum diameter (TD)
conditions: Holotype KU336975, field number JJW2336, sex as printed in Table 1: Male; locality Ranomafana, Maharira. Table 1 (caption 'Morphometric measurements (in mm) of the two new species.') has six specimen columns: S. lavabato KU336975 (holotype, male), KU336977 (paratype, male), KU336978 (paratype, female), ZSM 806/2003 (paratype, male); S. lakolosy KU340852 (holotype, 'Female?'), KU340867 (paratype, female). TD values in column order 2.4, 1.7, 2.0, 2.1, 1.8, 2.2; this record is column 1. Anatomy only; hearing not tested. Text statements on the same measurement (Results): S. lavabato Description of the holotype 'tympanum distinct, rounded, its diameter 60% of eye diameter'; S. lavabato Variation '…relative tympanum size (TD/ED 0.51 in the female, 0.49–0.62 in the two males)' although Table 1 has three S. lavabato males; S. lakolosy Description of the holotype 'tympanum distinct, rounded, its horizontal diameter 60% of eye diameter'. Table 1 ED row (horizontal eye diameter, mm) in column order 3.9, 3.5, 3.9, 2.9, 3.2, 3.2; TD/ED computed here (not printed; Table 1 has no ratio row): 0.62, 0.49, 0.51, 0.72, 0.56, 0.69. This column's TD/ED (0.62) agrees with the holotype text's 60% and with the Variation male range.
